title: Ẹ̀là sculpture at Ẹbu Ìyá Mọòpó
note: The geotagged March 2020 photograph and the published site map locate Ẹ̀là west of Ìyá Mọòpó. The photographed front faces about 118° true. The projected footing is 10.7 m from map marker 16. The phone reports 30 m horizontal uncertainty. The exact footing and bearing are approximate.
